SELECT e.isin, e.prd_nm, e.nav_ek
FROM etf_mst e
JOIN brnd b ON e.brnd_cd = b.brnd_cd
JOIN mgr m ON b.mgr_cd = m.mgr_cd
WHERE m.mgr_nm = '가람자산운용'
ORDER BY e.nav_ek DESC
LIMIT 1

)

LIMIT 1
